scope.head: f2033b0e58eb27f09d07b2be89d6737d21339b2c
scope.intent: replace the Node share helper with the Rust zos-hostd daemon and rename the complete runtime surface

resolvedSincePreviousReview: Bounded IPC concurrency to 64 connections and response writes to five seconds.
Rejected non-UTF-8 and configuration-injecting share paths.
Hardened atomic writes with final permissions, ownership, file fsync, rename, and parent-directory fsync.
Restricted mdadm array paths and validated live array membership before destructive deletion.
Added request-size, response-size, multi-frame, timeout, and socket-error HostdClient tests.
Refreshed disabled share services so removed protocol configuration takes effect.

testingGaps: Linux systemd sandbox and real privileged-command acceptance were not available on the macOS review host.
A Debian package was not built or installed during this local review because dpkg-buildpackage is unavailable.
residualRisks: Multiple services share the zos UID accepted by hostd, so peer identity is not isolated from API approval authority.
Client timeouts do not cancel hostd work already in progress.
The host installer executes rustup bootstrap content fetched over HTTPS without a pinned checksum.

verification.productionBuild: passed: Rust release, web, and docs
verification.documentation: passed: Astro check, tests, build, and internal-link validation
